dossier.headline: Hindalco's Q2 profit jumps 59%
dossier.summary: Hindalco reported a 58.8% rise in consolidated Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹7,533 crore, with EBITDA up 42% to ₹13,757 crore. The India business, including Utkal Alumina, posted EBITDA of ₹8,450 crore against Nuvama's ₹7,080 crore estimate, and Nuvama upgraded the stock to Buy with a ₹1,184 target.
